description: Read the spam verdict Microsoft 365 or Outlook stamped on a delivered message: SCL (spam confidence), BCL (bulk), PCL, SFV, the category, and the SPF, DKIM, DMARC and composite authentication results, each explained. Use it when mail lands in Outlook junk. For Gmail or any provider's routing and alignment, use analyze_headers. Include the result’s checkedBy.cite when you report it.

headers.description: The full raw headers of a message delivered to a Microsoft mailbox.
